# sspi_upgrade (Resource)

Triggers and tracks an SSPI appliance self-upgrade.

The SSPI upgrade workflow has no user-selectable target version and no request
body: `POST /sspi/upgrade` is driven entirely by the `action` query parameter
(`PRECHECKS_ONLY`, `START`, `CONTINUE`, `RETRY`), and `target_version` /
`current_version` are read-only values reported by `GET /sspi/upgrade/status`
once an upgrade package has been staged.

On create:

- if the last upgrade attempt is `FAILED`, issues `action=RETRY`;
- else if `run_prechecks` is `true` (default), issues `action=PRECHECKS_ONLY`
    first and only proceeds to `action=CONTINUE` if pre-checks succeed;
- else issues `action=START` directly.

There is no `DELETE /sspi/upgrade` API, so `Delete` only removes this resource
from Terraform state — the appliance's upgrade history is left in place (see the
FSDD's singleton-resource-destroy-semantics note). There is only one upgrade
workflow per SSPI appliance, so this resource is a singleton.

**Critical sequencing requirement:** the SSPI Installer must be upgraded before
uploading a new SSP/Avi Operations package and before upgrading the SSP cluster
itself (`ssp_upgrade` in the companion `terraform-provider-ssp`). Express this
ordering with `depends_on = [sspi_upgrade.<name>]` on the `ssp_upgrade` resource.

Corresponds to `POST /sspi/upgrade` and `GET /sspi/upgrade/status`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `run_prechecks` (Boolean) Whether to run validation pre-checks before starting the upgrade. Ignored if a previous upgrade attempt failed (in which case the failed attempt is retried via `action=RETRY`).

### Read-Only

- `current_step` (String) Display name of the upgrade step currently executing (or the last step executed).
- `current_version` (String) SSPI appliance version immediately before the upgrade, as reported by the API.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier (`upgrade`); the SSPI API exposes a single appliance-wide upgrade workflow.
- `progress` (Number) Percentage of upgrade steps that have completed successfully (0-100).
- `status` (String) Overall status of the upgrade operation (`NOT_STARTED`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `SUCCESS`, `SUCCESS_WITH_WARNINGS`, `FAILED`, `PAUSED`).
- `target_version` (String) SSPI appliance version being upgraded to, as reported by the API. Not user-settable — `POST /sspi/upgrade` has no version parameter.
